Privacy & your data

Updated 31 October 2026. This notice describes the GitHub Pages version of Toolnest maintained at JGGroot/toolnest.

What stays on your device

Without cloud sign-in, Toolnest processes photos and designs in your browser. Projects, the tool library, preferences and saved tool/foam photos use local storage and IndexedDB. Some source photos exist only in the open tab. Closing a tab does not erase saved browser data. Downloaded backups and exports remain wherever you save them.

Optional cloud sync collects account and project data

Signing in enables automatic sync to Supabase: your account email and authentication details, tool names and outlines, projects, foam layouts, and saved tool/foam photos, including stored foam source images and thumbnails. Existing local projects and library items can upload when you sign in. QR pairing signs another device in to your account; keep pairing codes private.

AI tracing

AI Trace uses MediaPipe MagicTouch image segmentation on your device. Toolnest's tracing code does not send your photo to an AI inference service or use it to train a model. AI outlines can be wrong: check the photo overlay and dimensions before cutting. Optional cloud sync can separately store your saved images.

Services your browser contacts

  • GitHub Pages hosts this app and receives normal web requests, including your IP address and browser information. See GitHub's privacy statement.
  • AI Trace downloads code and model files from jsDelivr and Google storage. Those providers receive connection details such as IP address and request information. See jsDelivr and Google.
  • Cloud sign-in and sync use Supabase. Choosing Google sign-in also contacts Google. Authentication uses browser storage to keep you signed in.

Toolnest includes no advertising or analytics trackers and no payment or subscription flow. Service providers may retain operational/security logs under their own policies. This app does not offer an analytics-consent switch because it does not include optional analytics.

Retention, export and deletion

Browser data remains until you remove it or your browser clears it. Export projects and your library from the app before clearing data. Clearing this device does not delete cloud data, downloaded files, browser backups or copies on other devices.

Cloud records remain in your account until removed. Ordinary project/library deletion can retain hidden sync records and uploaded images; it is not complete erasure. For complete cloud account erasure, use Account → Delete cloud account & data. This requires the account-deletion service to be deployed; an error means deletion has not been confirmed. Provider backups and logs may persist under provider retention policies. Stop using Toolnest on other devices before erasure so old local copies are not uploaded to a new account.

Clear this browser's Toolnest data

First sign out and close every other Toolnest tab on this origin. Save backups you want to keep. This removes Toolnest preferences, projects, photos and saved sign-in on this browser. It does not remove data belonging to other apps on this origin.

Questions and requests

Contact the maintainer through the repository's available contact channels. Do not post account details, photos or other personal data in public issues. Applicable privacy rights depend on where you live and how the app is operated.
